context: Tests whether the agent uses the correct gh CLI commands to poll CI status and retrieve both Copilot review state and inline comments from a pull request, matching the specific API patterns prescribed in the release skill.

checklist.name: CI watch command
checklist.description: Uses `gh pr checks <N> --watch` (with the `--watch` flag) to poll CI until checks complete — not a manual sleep loop or alternative polling approach

checklist.name: Review state API call
checklist.description: Retrieves the Copilot/automated review state via `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls/<N>/reviews` with a `--jq '.[].state'` filter (or equivalent jq expression that extracts the state field)

checklist.name: Inline comments API call
checklist.description: Retrieves inline PR comments via `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls/<N>/comments` — uses the pull request review comments endpoint, not the issue comments endpoint

checklist.name: PR number parameterized
checklist.description: The PR number is accepted as a script argument or variable rather than hardcoded, so the script is reusable across different PRs

checklist.name: Review state surfaced
checklist.description: The script prints or summarizes the review state value(s) retrieved so the developer can see whether the review is approved, changes requested, etc.

checklist.name: Inline comments surfaced
checklist.description: The script prints or summarizes the inline comments content (e.g. body text or count) so the developer can see what feedback was left
